customize.name: Tofu con uova di granchio sospetto
customize.desc: A dish with a tender mouthfeel. Even the freshest crab roe cannot mask the taste of over-aged tofu. Crushing it up with your chopsticks and mixing it into white rice is all you can do to force it down your gullet.

customize.name: Tofu con uova di granchio
customize.desc: A dish with a tender mouthfeel. Crab roe is stir-fried till the oil within oozes out before being added to boiled tofu and accented with broth. Simple, yes, but gloriously fresh.

customize.name: Tofu con uova di granchio delizioso
customize.desc: A dish with a tender mouthfeel. The tofu is so tender that it might break if you blew on a spoonful of it. Each granule of the crab roe is plump and filled with crab oil that oozes out onto your lips the moment you have a single bite. Chewing is not needed at all. The food travels down your gullet in a flash, leaving nothing but the memory of its fresh flavor.

customize.name: A modo mio
customize.desc: La specialità di Yanfei è il tofu con uova di granchio, realizzato con un'incredibile regolarità. Le sue dimensioni e il suo sapore sono tutti fedelmente resi secondo le "Leggi del tofu delle uova di granchio" nella ricetta, senza omettere una sola lettera.

customize.desc: Un germoglio di bambù fresco, appena estratto dal suolo. Un ingrediente culinario delizioso dall'aroma esotico, reperibile esclusivamente nelle regioni temperate.

customize.name: Pollame

customize.name: Tofu all'orchidea sospetto
customize.desc: A dish that is a test of one's knifework. The erratic knifework here has caused the ingredients to be sliced every which way. The tattered mouthfeel is enough to make one despair. Only the rank taste of beans stands as proof that the main ingredient of this dish was tofu in the first place.

customize.name: Tofu all'orchidea
customize.desc: A dish that is a test of one's knifework. All the ingredients were sliced into ribbons in a single go, and after being washed, they were placed into the broth and cooked till they floated. The resulting flavor is light and fresh, and would not be out of place as a chef's recommendation in a Liyue restaurant.

customize.name: Tofu all'orchidea delizioso
customize.desc: A dish that is a test of one's knifework. The tofu, thread-thin as the autumn leaves, floats amidst the bowl, like mist in a forest, and the shredded bamboo shoots give the image a sweet, lustrous sheen, while the broth combines the essence of fowl and ham, giving off an unbelievable aroma. A single taste is enough to cause the customer to lose themselves in this fog of flavor.

customize.name: Zuppa di miso sospetta
customize.desc: A simple and unadorned soup dish. The wilted seagrass, the crushed little bits of tofu, and the overly thick flavor are a real hazard to one's mood if consumed first thing in the morning.

customize.name: Zuppa di miso
customize.desc: A simple and unadorned soup dish. The ingredients used here are very common and it is made simply, but this small bowl of soup has the power to ensure that you shall not grow weary on your journey, even if you travel on foot.

customize.name: Zuppa di miso deliziosa
customize.desc: A simple and unadorned soup dish. The flavorful soup gives off a leaven fragrance. One mouthful of this with rice will ensure the completeness of the entire meal.

customize.name: Calore
customize.desc: Thoma's specialty. The intricate appearance of this dish belies the simple ingredients used. But take a sip, and Thoma's sunshine smile comes straight to mind. Perhaps this is his special ability: warming the hearts of others using the simplest of ingredients.

customize.name: Riso
customize.desc: A grain crop commonly found in Teyvat. People of all walks of life enjoy its distinct grainy texture. As the saying goes, "The same kind of rice can feed one hundred kinds of people."

customize.name: Tofu

customize.name: Vieni a prenderlo! sospetto
customize.desc: A dish made out of a luxurious variety of ingredients... dumped into scalding-hot water and boiled beyond recognition. As if the taste of everything and nothing at the same time isn't bad enough, you'll want to watch out for the sand, too...

customize.name: Vieni a prenderlo!
customize.desc: A dish made out of a luxurious variety of ingredients. There is no great refinement in the making of this food, and it appears in Liyue often during festival season. Whenever this dish is served up, the person at the head of the table will invite everyone to dig in, saying "Come on, eat, eat," hence the name.

customize.name: Vieni a prenderlo! delizioso
customize.desc: A dish made out of a luxurious variety of ingredients. The mixture of meat and vegetables is spot-on, the presentation is flawless, and the blend of flavors in the broth brings out the best of everything. Don't mind if I do.

customize.name: Frutto di loto
customize.desc: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.

customize.name: Zuppa di gemme sospetta
customize.desc: Una semplice zuppa di verdure. La zuppa è così insipida che sembra fatta con la verdura morente di una fattoria abbandonata.

customize.name: Zuppa di gemme
customize.desc: Una semplice zuppa di verdure. La bocca di leone, il tofu e i semi di loto vengono lentamente fatti bollire nell'acqua. La zuppa di gemme ha preso il suo nome dall'aspetto che acquisiscono i suoi ingredienti durante la cottura. Contrariamente al suo appellativo, è una zuppa che viene comunemente preparata e servita dalle famiglie ordinarie.

customize.name: Zuppa di gemme deliziosa
customize.desc: Una semplice zuppa di verdure. Il delicato sapore della zuppa viene condito dai vari tipi di verdura fresca. Questa zuppa è capace di riscaldare il cuore e di far invidia anche ai piatti più lussuosi.

customize.name: Zuppa di gnocchi di riso sospetta
customize.desc: Commonly-seen city cuisine. These ingredients have cooked for so long that they have gone crisp. The only way to tell the components apart is by trawling the mix, having a small spoonful, and initiating further analysis.

customize.name: Zuppa di gnocchi di riso
customize.desc: Commonly-seen city cuisine. The ingredients have gorged themselves on the soup, making them most enticing indeed. They say that in the first, this dish only had a scant few ingredients, but more were added as time passed, resulting in its present form.

customize.name: Zuppa di gnocchi di riso deliziosa
customize.desc: Commonly-seen city cuisine. The freshness of light soup forms the perfect backdrop for the original flavor of the ingredients to stand out, giving you that ancient taste of Inazuma City. This back-to-basics cuisine is sure to make you feel warm inside when eaten on a snowy night as you travel alone.
